purpose: Allow stock Google-native MIRA to use LAN-only services without requiring a MIRROR server or exposing local service credentials to ChatGPT.

transport.poller: explicitly enrolled MIRA Windows, Linux, or Android client on the local network
transport.local_credentials: stored only in OS-protected client storage; never written to Google or ChatGPT
transport.offline_behavior: actions remain pending with expiry; never duplicate completed idempotency keys
